name: Tuition Academia
source:
Take control of a customizable female protagonist in an exciting, roleplay, life simulation game where you try to pay off your student debt. Work several risqué side jobs while trying to balance the day-to-day of college. How far will you go to earn that money? Will you remain innocent?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880710/Tuition_Academia/]Steam[/url]]
